about: Fund-level money actions on City Council agendas, one row per fund per item. Amounts are as stated in the item's staff report. 'kind': spend = one-time spending authority; annual = recurring cost (negative = saving); authority = permission to solicit bids, not yet spending; revenue = new money in; passthrough = collected for an outside body. 'status': proposed until the meeting, then adopted / amended / pulled. Add a block for each new budget scan.
